items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 35:1
items.html: (To the question) In the Mochin of face to face the Nukva receives from the left of AA, and in the Mochin of the separation, which are the Mochin of the posterior, she receives from the Netzach of AA, by the inclusion of the Netzach in his Hod.
